advisory.summary: Projection vectors computed from same 200 seqs used for eval. Acceptable for no-training SVD, but consider 100/100 cal/eval split if results are borderline.
GPT-2 is pre-norm: LN at block input. Verify projection is inserted after residual addition (x + FFN(LN(x))), before next block's input LN. Wrong insertion point would be undone by LN.

notes: No-training correction: SVD + projection, zero learned params. Clean experimental design.
Error rank analysis (step 3) provides early diagnostic — if rank_95 > 32, expect refutation.
Cascade refit (step 6) directly measures whether the correction changes the structural constant c.
